name: Melatja
title: Rebuilder of Jerusalem's Wall
summary: Melatja was a Gibeonite who participated in the rebuilding of Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah's leadership. He is mentioned in Nehemiah 3:7 as one of those who repaired the wall together with others from Gibeon and Mizpah. His effort was part of the great joint project to restore Jerusalem after the exile in Babylon.

keyEvents.title: Rebuilding of Jerusalem's Wall
keyEvents.description: Melatja from Gibeon took part in repairing Jerusalem's wall at the Old Gate, along with Jadon from Meronoth and men from Gibeon and Mizpah.

keyEvents.title: Nehemiah's Organization of the Wall Work
keyEvents.description: Nehemiah organized the people into groups to rebuild different sections of Jerusalem's wall. Melatja was among those assigned a specific section.

keyEvents.title: Opposition to the Rebuilding
keyEvents.description: Despite opposition from enemies like Sanballat and Tobiah, Melatja and the other workers continued to rebuild the wall.

keyEvents.title: Completion of the Wall
keyEvents.description: The wall was completed in 52 days, a project to which Melatja and many others faithfully contributed.
